story.title: Ethereum Dramatically Outperformed the S&P 500 in Q3. Is It Finally Time to Load Up on Ethereum? - The Motley Fool

facts.text: One great quarter doesn't justify going overboard on Ethereum (CRYPTO: ETH) purchases, though owning some is a great idea, and adding a little right now still makes a lot of sense given what could be on the way.
The coin surged by 66% in the third quarter, marking its best quarter since its wild run in 2021, while the S&P 500 gained just 2% amid considerable global uncertainty.
Ether is down by 37% over the last five years.
Even with the index frozen in place, Ether would need to gain quite a lot to catch up, and that might take a while, if it happens.
Bullish investors are already sounding off in anticipation of the uptrend continuing.
Tom Lee, chairman of BitMine Immersion Technologies , says Ethereum is "dwarfing" other major assets.
Furthermore, the capital that's parked on Ethereum tends to move as its owners seek a return.
The chain collected $354,748 in fees over the 24 hours ending Oct.
While it's true that this income is on the small side for a network of this size, it's also proof that people are willing to pay up to gain access to the opportunities there.
That's a strong indicator that the coin has at least some value.
Today, Ethereum hosts $147.9 billion in stablecoins and $17 billion in tradeable tokenized real-world assets.
This means it has billions in assets, such as Treasury bills, recorded as crypto tokens on its blockchain.
Ethereum's decentralized finance (DeFi) ecosystem offers both of those features more than any other crypto network.
One compelling reason not to bet the farm on Ethereum is that it still trades below its level five years ago.
The Motley Fool Stock Advisor analyst team just identified what they believe are the 10 best stocks for investors to buy now… and Ethereum wasn’t one of them.
The 10 stocks that made the cut could produce monster returns in the coming years.
But investors should know that a climbing chart is not the same as having an investment thesis.
Getting too enthusiastic with purchasing at the moment could quickly become a poor decision if Ethereum cools down a bit.
Before you buy stock in Ethereum, consider this:
Ethereum is worth owning because it's the main hub for capital in the crypto universe.
So be sure to hold some Ethereum in your crypto portfolio if you don't already.
